payload.text: **0087 -- the D19 wrapper-flag defect, vc builds, dc reviews, fixed before the release (hv, 2026-09-18).** The command-level gate at lib/resolve:909-915 appends raw "$@" after -- and never calls gate_split_args, so --purge, --purge-only and --allow-empty reach the tool as arguments. Plan: a behavioural arm per flag, red first; gate_split_args at the site; a class arm that every run_gate site forwarding user argv routes it through gate_split_args; the D19 comment and gate_split_args' header corrected to point at the arm rather than enumerate sites. Vendored: lib/resolve, lib/runlog -> the release pre-notice.
